services.name: Two Hour Private Charter
services.desc: We make sure to cater to you, so you have the experience you are looking for! Whether you are wanting to anchor at Crab Island or get away from the crowd, we want to make this the highlight of your vacation! checkin: We're looking forward to your reservation! We are at the marina at Gilligans Watersports located 530 Harbor Boulevard, Destin, FL 32541. Make sure to text me when you arrive. DO NOT USE APPLE MAPS, PEOPLE SEEM TO HAVE ISSUES FINDING OUR MARINA. WE RECOMMEND WAZE OR GOOGLE No smoking is allowed on the boat or on any mats. It must be done in the water. Ecigs/vapes are allowed.
